'''Offra''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and a rival of [[Skeedo]] the Hutt during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Offra hired individuals to deliver an arms shipment to the military on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skeressa]].<ref name="Mission" /> However, the shipment was hijacked by Skeedo's minions.<ref name="Mission" />
